plugins.name: socialinsider
plugins.description: Social media analytics for Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn and X. Pull live engagement, reach and follower data from your Socialinsider account, then have Claude audit profiles, benchmark competitors and recap campaigns.

skills.name: campaign-recap
skills.description: Recap a social media campaign or content pillar using Socialinsider data — volume published, engagement earned, best posts, and how it compares to non-campaign output. Use when the user asks how a campaign, launch, hashtag or content pillar performed, wants a campaign wrap-up or post-mortem, or asks whether a content theme is working.

skills.name: competitor-benchmark
skills.description: Benchmark a brand against its competitors on social media using Socialinsider data — share of engagement, posting cadence, engagement rate and format mix side by side. Use when the user asks how they compare to competitors, wants a competitive or industry benchmark, share-of-voice analysis, or asks who is winning on a platform.

skills.name: profile-audit
skills.description: Audit how one social media profile performed over a period using Socialinsider data — followers and engagement trend, aggregate post metrics, post-type mix, and the posts that actually worked. Use when the user asks how a profile, account, brand or channel is doing, wants a performance review, monthly report, engagement-rate check, or asks why reach or engagement moved.
